description: Construction Pipeline (Historical) is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Pursuant to 312(a) of the City Charter, as amended by Local Law 63 of 2011, the Mayor's Office is required to publish a plan and schedule for each City agency detailing the anticipated contracting actions of each agency for the upcoming fiscal year for certain categories of procurement. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are construction pipeline. The table has 23 columns. Attribution on the portal: Mayor's Office of Contract Services (MOCS). The portal shows 2016-04-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
